channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Why new USC defensive coordinator Gary Patterson returned to coaching
item.description: Patterson, now a Hall of Fame coach, is taking the reins of the Trojans’ defense with renewed perspective on the sport. “I’ve been out for three years, so I got a chance to watch more football and evaluate people about how you play defense, how the game is going,” he says.

item.title: Lakers routed by Cavaliers in LeBron James’ emotional return to Cleveland
item.description: Luka Doncic returns from an early injury scare but his 29 points aren’t nearly enough to help the Lakers keep pace in the second half of a 129-99 loss. James gets choked up during a video tribute and has one of his worst games ever as an opponent in Cleveland.

item.title: Chargers hire Chris O’Leary as their new defensive coordinator
item.description: O’Leary, who was the Chargers’ safeties coach in 2024, replaces Jesse Minter, who left last week to become the Baltimore Ravens’ head coach.

item.title: UCLA men coast to victory over short-handed, slumping Oregon
item.description: Tyler Bilodeau has 18 points, Eric Dailey Jr. adds a double-double and the Bruins handle a Ducks team that is missing three of its top four scorers, 73-57, for a third straight win.

item.title: Hollywood Burbank Airport officials say safety is ‘our top priority’
item.description: NTSB Board Chair Jennifer Homendy said airline officials have told her "the next mid-air (collision) is going to be at Burbank"

item.title: San Bernardino Valley College men’s basketball team powers past Chaffey
item.description: Duante Murphy led four players in double figures with 17 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds as the Wolverines remain unbeaten in IEAC play.

item.title: Dense fog advisory active for 5 Freeway through Grapevine until Thursday midday – visibility limited to 1/4 mile
item.description: 5 Freeway through Grapevine is the focus of a dense fog advisory issued at 2:21 a.m. on Thursday by the National Weather Service. The advisory is in effect until noon.

item.title: Unmentioned but present, Trump is a common denominator in efforts to strengthen Asia-Europe ties
item.description: Trump's shaking up of the global order is worrying friends and foes and driving them closer.

item.title: US appeals court says Noem’s decision to end protections for Venezuelans in US was illegal
item.description: The decision will not have any immediate practical effect after the Supreme Court in October allowed Noem’s decision to take effect pending a final decision by the justices.

item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: The new videos have rekindled the national debate about the death of Pretti.
